title: Cardinal Roadside Assistance Benefit Schedule: Service Call Allowance
content:
## Schedule of benefits: covered service call allowance

Each Cardinal Roadside Assistance option on a vehicle holds an allowance of covered service calls for each allowance period. The allowance period runs for the number of months shown below, counted from the option effective date and from each anniversary of that date.

| Option | Covered service calls per allowance period | Allowance period | Unused calls carry into the next period | After the allowance is used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | 3 | 12 months | No | Member pays the provider's rate |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | 4 | 12 months | No | Member pays the provider's rate |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | 4 | 12 months | No | Member pays the provider's rate |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | 5 | 12 months | No | Member pays the provider's rate |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | 6 | 12 months | No | Member pays the provider's rate |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | 6 | 12 months | No | Member pays the provider's rate |

### Reading the schedule

- **Calls per period.** The figure is a whole number of covered service calls available in one allowance period of the option.
- **Allowance period.** On every option the period is 12 months long, beginning on the option effective date and again on each anniversary of it.
- **Carryover.** No option carries unused calls forward: an allowance period opens with the scheduled number of calls whatever was left at the end of the period before.
- **After the allowance.** On every option, once the calls of the period are used, a further call is handled with the member paying the provider's rate.

### Schedule questions

**Which options give the most calls?** Cardinal Roadside Premier and Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer, with 6 covered service calls per period each.

**Do Cardinal Roadside Standard and Cardinal Roadside Plus differ in their allowance?** No. Both hold 4 covered service calls per 12-month period.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Cardinal Roadside Basic option that ends an allowance period with 1 call unused begins its next 12-month period with 3 calls, not 4, because carryover is "No" on that option.
